description: Unofficial Eyrie fan-art animated companion inspired by Neopets. This golden griffin carries a warm light along a cream wing, arranges and recovers a paper feather in a soft purple holder, fans both wings and waits with a small ear twitch. Original choreography includes articulated right, left and forward trots and a wing-balanced low hop. Broad forepaws, splayed three-toed hindfeet and five main feather panels per wing are declared drawing simplifications.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
